title: MIDDAY PRAYER
2 CHRONICLES 20:12
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday light through office window
empty wooden desk with warm sun
soft shadows on a clean white wall
sunlight glinting off a glass of water
dust motes dancing in shaft of light
open field under a high bright sun

scenes.a: That heavy choice weighing on your mind is why you are meant to stay here.
Lord, we arrive at this hour with our hands empty and our strength fully spent.
O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
Grant us the quiet stillness to wait while You move in ways we cannot see.
Replace our frantic worry with the steady peace of knowing You are already acting today.
May our hearts remain fixed on Your face as the hours pass, in Jesus' name.
